tests.name: R+ action freeness
tests.details: Tested 7 values of lambda. Action is free: no lambda != 1 fixes all quantities.

tests.name: Dimensionless quantities invariant under R+
tests.details: All dim=0 quantities unchanged under rescaling (as expected).

tests.name: All orbit points satisfy bootstrap equations
Irreducibility: adding 'ratio sqrt_sigma/M_P' preserves fiber
tests.details: Max residual on orbit: 6.02e-36. Fiber persists — equation is degree 0 (scale-homogeneous).

tests.name: Irreducibility: adding 'ratio (R_stella/ell_P)^3' preserves fiber
tests.details: Max residual on orbit: 2.22e-16. Fiber persists — equation is degree 0 (scale-homogeneous).

tests.name: Irreducibility: adding 'product sqrt_sigma^2 * R_stella^2' preserves fiber
tests.details: Max residual on orbit: 2.18e-11. Fiber persists — equation is degree 0 (scale-homogeneous).

tests.name: One input (R_stella) uniquely selects fiber point
tests.details: After fixing R_stella: recovered R = 0.4484700000 fm (target: 0.44847 fm, error: 0.00e+00)

tests.name: One input determines all other dimensionful quantities
Dimensionless system: entire R+ orbit is valid
tests.details: All 5 degree-0 equations have CONSTANT residual across lambda in [1e-5, 1e5]. Worst variation: 1.78e-15 (epsilon_3). Scale is completely undetermined — any lambda gives an equally valid solution.

tests.name: Inhomogeneous eq (R_stella = 0.44847) breaks fiber
tests.details: Of 500 orbit points, only 0 satisfy R_stella = 0.44847 fm. Fiber is collapsed to a point.

tests.name: Information content of R_stella
tests.details: Range: 132.9 bits, Precision: 3.8 bits, Total: 136.7 bits (theorem claims ~137).

tests.name: Dimensionless ratios invariant on fiber (S_bar well-defined)
tests.details: All ratios invariant under R+ scaling. R_stella/ell_P = 2.774747e+19, sqrt_sigma/M_P = 3.603932e-20.

tests.name: Adversarial: N_c * R_stella is still scale-homogeneous
Adversarial: f(R/ell_P) is scale-invariant for any f
tests.details: Any function of dimensionless ratios is scale-invariant (tested log, sin).

tests.name: Adversarial: floor(R/ell_P) is still scale-invariant
tests.details: floor(R/ell_P) = 27747471876631175168. Non-analytic function of dimensionless ratio is still invariant.

tests.name: Second input (sqrt_sigma) is redundant
tests.details: R_stella -> sqrt_sigma = 440.0004 MeV (matches 440.0004 MeV). Second input adds no information.

tests.name: Contradictory second input is detected
tests.details: If sqrt_sigma = 500.0 MeV but R_stella predicts 440.0 MeV: system is inconsistent. Second input is either redundant or contradictory.
